When something goes wrong, Parley asks whether to tell us.

- **One-tap problem reports** when the app sees a failure: an empty or cut-short transcript, a recording that keeps failing to sync, a microphone that kept dropping. Reports carry diagnostics only, never recordings or transcripts.
- **Report the screen you just screenshotted** (Android 14 and later), or use **Report a problem** in the Account sheet.
- **Crash reports are sent automatically.** Turn that off under Feedback & diagnostics.
